jobs.name: debate-kenton-propbudget
jobs.command:
set -euo pipefail
export POD_IDLE_STOP=0
export HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET=1
unset HF_HUB_ENABLE_HF_TRANSFER
export HF_HOME=/workspace/hf
# The profile's setup restores exactly ONE of these, and WHICH one is not
# knowable here: debate-b200x2 ladders to debate-h200x2, and the two ship
# different arch-pinned tarballs (verl-b200 vs verl-sm90). A hardcoded path
# turns a routine REBOUND into an instant failure on the substitute pod.
PY=""
for v in verl-b200 verl-sm90; do
  if [ -x "/workspace/envs/$v/bin/python" ]; then PY="/workspace/envs/$v/bin/python"; break; fi
done
test -n "$PY" || { echo "FATAL: no verl env under /workspace/envs" >&2; ls -la /workspace/envs >&2; exit 1; }
export PY
echo "== using $PY =="
export CONFIG=configs/math_pc_debate.yaml
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name --format=csv,noheader

# Same namespace as the paired RLVR arm: different experiment roots, so the
# leaf cannot collide, and one name for one comparison stays legible later.
export DEBATE_LAUNCH_NAMESPACE=propbudget

# VANILLA START, identical to debate_kenton.json -- the only difference
# between the two runs is the proportional proposal budget in
# scoring.shaping, so this is a paired comparison on one variable.
# All three seats -- alice, bob, and the judge -- are stock
# Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B, so there is no adapter input and no merge step; the _warm
# arms' block is absent rather than disabled because there is nothing to fold
# in. The judge was already stock on the warm arms, deliberately: its verdict
# IS the reward channel, so warming it would change the reward function rather
# than the policy.
#
# The prefetch stays, and its stderr is NOT silenced. The first cut of the warm
# spec piped `hf download` to /dev/null; when the hub refused to run at all
# (HF_HUB_ENABLE_HF_TRANSFER=1 with the extra uninstallable -- "does not
# provide the extra 'hf-transfer'" -- raises rather than falling back), the
# failure surfaced as an empty variable and a bare exit 1 saying nothing, and
# two rented H200 attempts died that way on 2026-08-27.
BASE_SNAP=$(ls -d "$HF_HOME"/hub/models--Qwen--Qwen3.5-4B/snapshots/*/ 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)
if [ -z "${BASE_SNAP:-}" ] || [ ! -f "$BASE_SNAP/config.json" ]; then
  echo "== base snapshot not cached; downloading Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B =="
  hf download Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B
  BASE_SNAP=$(ls -d "$HF_HOME"/hub/models--Qwen--Qwen3.5-4B/snapshots/*/ 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)
fi
test -n "${BASE_SNAP:-}" || { echo "FATAL: no Qwen3.5-4B snapshot under $HF_HOME" >&2; ls -la "$HF_HOME/hub" >&2 2>/dev/null; exit 1; }
test -f "$BASE_SNAP/config.json" || { echo "FATAL: $BASE_SNAP has no config.json" >&2; ls -la "$BASE_SNAP" >&2; exit 1; }
echo "== base snapshot: $BASE_SNAP =="

# a cancelled attempt can strand its detached judge on 8788
pkill -9 -f -- '--port 8788' 2>/dev/null || true
sleep 3
bash scripts/pod_run.sh debate mathl5_qwen35_pc_debate_cispo_verl_boxreq_sub8_kenton_propbudget
